data.description: Whether players leave a trail of sparkles while they sneak.

meta.notes: A game rule: a world setting registered with the mod and saved with each world. "kind" is boolean (on or off) or integer (a whole number, with "min" and "max"); "default" is its value in a new world; "category" is the group of the game rule screen it is listed in; "display_name" and "description" are its words there. Players set it with /gamerule msm_examples:sparkle_trails false. A rule reads it with "The game rule is" and changes it with "Set a game rule". It needs the Fabric mod jar export; the vanilla packs keep only its models, pictures and language keys.
